units.source_text: 有了钱之后，杜子春购置了豪华府邸，衣食住行极尽奢靡，比玄宗皇帝还要奢侈三分。

en.t: After he came into money, Toshishun bought a magnificent mansion and lived in extreme luxury in every part of daily life, even more extravagantly than Emperor Xuanzong.

units.source_text: 饮兰陵美酒，食桂州龙眼，一日四变色的牡丹在庭院里随意种植，数只白孔雀在院里放养。

en.t: He drank fine Lanling wine and ate longans from Guizhou; peonies that changed color four times a day were planted freely in the garden, and several white peacocks were kept loose in the courtyard.

units.source_text: 他广收美玉，遍裁绫罗，造香木车，制象牙椅，倘若想记录下他所有的奢侈行为，恐怕不知道耗费多少时光呢。

en.t: He collected beautiful jade far and wide, cut every kind of fine silk, made carriages of fragrant wood, and fashioned ivory chairs; if one tried to record all his acts of extravagance, there is no telling how much time it would take.
